title: Jewellery Industry Solutions
description: Advanced ERP solutions tailored for jewellery manufacturers, ensuring precise precious metal tracking, design management and production control while maintaining quality and security standards.

infoCards.title: Production Management
infoCards.description: Comprehensive jewellery production system with design and material tracking.

infoCards.title: Quality Control
infoCards.description: Advanced quality assurance system for precious metals and stones.

faqData.question: How does the system manage precious metal inventory?
faqData.answer: Our system provides precise tracking of precious metals with weight management, purity tracking, wastage control and complete audit trail from raw material to finished product.

faqData.question: What design management features are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes comprehensive design management with CAD integration, 3D model storage, version control and detailed specifications for each design variant.

faqData.question: Can it handle stone inventory and grading?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution manages detailed stone inventory with grading specifications, certification tracking and stone setting management for various jewellery types.
